item.title: $400M White House ballroom plan faces public review

item.description: Arlington firefighters and their union are sounding the alarm over a proposed plan that could consolidate two rescue companies into one, potentially impacting 12 firefighters’ roles and resources. item.title: Daylight Saving Time: Virginia waiting on Maryland, DC to get rid of it
item.description: As daylight saving time approaches, the argument to make it permanent in the United States has resurfaced yet again.The Virginia Senate passed a bill last month to end the state's observance of daylight saving time, moving to Eastern Standard Time year-round. It will now move onto the House. item.title: House rejects Iran war powers resolution
item.description: The U.S. House on Thursday narrowly voted against a war powers resolution that would have required congressional approval before any further attacks are carried out in Iran. The close 212-219 vote offered a snapshot of political support – and opposition – to the U.S.-Israel military invasion and Trump's reasons for bypassing Congress. item.title: First flights out of Middle East land at Dulles Airport
